chunks: They link Him with the jinn by lineage, yet the jinn know that they will be brought before Him.
ai.seo_question: Who did the polytheers link God to as offspring, and what did they know about themselves?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the pre-Islamic Arab belief that Allah had female offspring among the jinn, a notion that reduces the Divine to a finite, mortal category. The phrase 'they themselves knew' underscores the inherent logical contradiction: if jinn are created beings subject to death and resurrection, they cannot be divine, making the attribution of lineage to God an act of ignorance despite their own awareness of the Hereafter.
